Subject: Prompted demo — usage threshold hit (Arcadia Labs)

Hi Sara,

Congrats on hitting the self-serve usage threshold — I saw Arcadia just crossed the 100k token mark this week. That usually indicates folks are ready to see a short walkthrough of how to get predictable latency and lower per-token cost with Redwood.

I'd love to schedule a 30-minute prompted demo focused on:
- Quick overview of model options and routing policies
- How to set up prefix/KV caching for recurring queries
- Cost/perf levers (batching, quantization suggestions)
- Quick Q&A and next steps (trial-to-dedicated pathway)

Here are some windows I have this week (PDT):
• Thu 6/11 — 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
• Fri 6/12 — 09:00–09:30 or 16:00–16:30

If any of those work, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (attached). If not, tell me a few times that do and I’ll accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Jordan Blake
SDR, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: RDW-prompted-demo-agenda.pdf, arcadia-usage-snapshot.csv
